output.subject: Thinking of Hunter / Quick hello
output.email:
Hi Matthew,

I was just thinking about the team at Hunter and wanted to reach out.

I’ve been keeping an eye on your industry lately and it’s been interesting to see how things are shifting. If you ever want a fresh perspective or just need someone to bounce an idea off of, I’m always happy to help out where I can—no pressure at all.

Hope your week is off to a great start.
